notes:
Rebuilds the Tauri shell so the UI actually ships the new rod options. 1.1.3 through 1.1.5 copied a prebuilt blackpanda.exe that predated the HTML by eight hours, so Xorcist, RecordBreaker and Maelstrom were in the Lua bundle but absent from both rod dropdowns. The packager now refuses to run when the shell is older than anything in ui/web.

Rod coverage since 1.1.3: Xorcist (static-meter supercharge policy), RecordBreaker (notch-vs-target rotation timing, right-click submit, rate-adaptive for rest mode), Maelstrom (charge-aware release gate holding until the fill clears 0.85), and a rewritten Pinion's Aria that enumerates live notes instead of looking them up by name.

Update channel: the checker queries every manifest source and keeps the highest version instead of stopping at the first response, so a stale CDN edge can no longer mask a published release.
